name: Hyams 2022 pediatric vedolizumab HUBBLE scenarios
description: Exact main-text source-value checks plus source-limited reduced dynamic probes.

scenarios.name: Source status and identity checks
scenarios.description: Exact citation rank, corrected PMID, source-status, and article identity checks.

scenarios.name: HUBBLE design and dosing checks
scenarios.description: Exact phase 2 randomization, dosing, sampling, and analysis-population checks.

scenarios.name: Baseline population checks
scenarios.description: Exact sample-size and high-level age checks from the abstract and Tables 1/3/4.

scenarios.name: Week 14 Ctrough checks
scenarios.description: Exact main-text Ctrough mean/SD checks for combined UC/CD by weight and dose.

scenarios.name: Table 3 adult-measure response checks
scenarios.description: Exact Week 14 Mayo/CDAI response counts, percentages, and exact confidence intervals.

scenarios.name: Supplement-referenced endpoint range checks
scenarios.description: Main-text ranges for endpoints whose full by-arm tables are in the blocked DOCX supplement.

scenarios.name: ADA and safety checks
scenarios.description: Exact main-text immunogenicity, exposure duration, hypersensitivity, and Table 4 safety checks.

scenarios.name: >=30 kg high-dose 300 mg probe
scenarios.description: Reduced one-compartment IV trajectory smoke scenario. Exact validation checks only regimen, dose-per-kg, selected reported Ctrough target, and reported response scalar.

scenarios.name: >=30 kg low-dose 150 mg probe
scenarios.description: Reduced one-compartment IV trajectory smoke scenario. Exact validation checks only regimen, dose-per-kg, selected reported Ctrough target, and reported response scalar.

scenarios.name: <30 kg high-dose 200 mg probe
scenarios.description: Reduced one-compartment IV trajectory smoke scenario. Exact validation checks only regimen, dose-per-kg, selected reported Ctrough target, and reported response scalar.
